OpenRouter is officially part of @stripe today!
More than 10 million developers and companies use OpenRouter, and as they build with more models across more workloads, they need control over what it costs and where their data goes.
OpenRouter has built that operating infrastructure to help run AI across every model and provider, with access to new models, uptime through outages, and enforced spend and data policies for each team.
Joining Stripe, which has spent years running critical infrastructure for businesses around the world, means we can build it faster and support companies at every scale.
Our commitment to neutrality stays the same. Models and providers compete on quality, reliability, and price. You decide what works for your business.

Nous Research (@NousResearch)
We've partnered with @Microsoft to bring Hermes Agent to the enterprise.
Hermes Enterprise now works inside Microsoft Teams, the Microsoft Store and Azure. In Teams, employees hand Hermes work like financial analysis, document drafts or inbox triage, and review the result in the same chat. Agent workloads run in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes.
When someone finds a good way to do a recurring task, Hermes saves it as a skill. With Collective Wisdom, they can share that skill with their team after review, so the next person starts out with the best approach anyone has found to accomplish that task. The skills then grow along with the company.
Companies with strict data residency or procurement rules can run Hermes Enterprise in their own Azure tenant. Our CTO Jeffrey Quesnelle presents how Hermes uses these sandboxes at Microsoft Ignite today, in session BRK448.
Thanks to @M12vc and the @Azure Container Apps team.

History was made today. Humanity will look back on 2026 and think: this was the threshold we crossed, the moment the future changed for everyone, forever.
People probably first sensed that something was shifting in late 2025 with Claude Code, when agentic AI became truly tangible for them. In the first half of 2026, things picked up speed. Model releases became more frequent, and everyone could feel the gaps between models and the improvements becoming more and more tangible. In the second half of 2026, however, there was a qualitative leap. It was no longer just the models getting better. It was the insights, the results, the outputs, the scientific solutions produced with AI that became more impressive, and today they have probably reached their absolute peak.
OpenAI led the way and solved the Navier-Stokes problem, a Millennium Prize Problem that humans had failed to solve for a very, very long time. A few weeks later, they published results on more than 300 open mathematical problems, many of which had also gone unsolved for decades. The entire scientific world was stunned, frozen in shock. But today Anthropic went a step further. Levent Alpöge, working with Claude, has almost certainly proven the Riemann Hypothesis. This is, and it’s hard to put into words, incredible and unfathomable. Today, I would say, is the proof of superintelligence. One of the greatest mathematical problems, if not the greatest, unsolved for 167 years, the holy grail of mathematics and science, has fallen. And it follows, and this should be clear to everyone, that all other problems will fall too.
We know that the development of AI models keeps moving forward relentlessly, and that this is just one step on the path to ever better models. And if the Riemann Hypothesis has already been proven today, there is simply no telling what even better models will solve. Dario Amodei said that AI will in all likelihood cure diseases, perhaps even all diseases. And although these are two different scientific disciplines, the significance of these breakthroughs shows that this is becoming more and more likely. 2026 will go down in human history as a turning point, the moment the singularity became tangible. And 2027 will be the year the singularity breaks into reality with full force and full impact.
I am in shock and excitement and I don't know what to think. But deep inside if feel joy.
This day is one of the best days ever for all of us.

Hermes ❤️ Microsoft
Nous Research partnered with Microsoft in order to bring Hermes to Enterprise.

> “In Teams, employees hand Hermes work like financial analysis, document drafts or inbox triage, and review the result in the same chat.”

A huge step for Hermes expansion! 👀
Nous Research (@NousResearch)
We've partnered with @Microsoft to bring Hermes Agent to the enterprise.
Hermes Enterprise now works inside Microsoft Teams, the Microsoft Store and Azure. In Teams, employees hand Hermes work like financial analysis, document drafts or inbox triage, and review the result in the same chat. Agent workloads run in isolated Azure Container Apps sandboxes.

With Collective Wisdom, they can share that skill with their team after review, so the next person starts out with the best approach anyone has found to accomplish that task. The skills then grow along with the company.
Companies with strict data residency or procurement rules can run Hermes Enterprise in their own Azure tenant. Our CTO Jeffrey Quesnelle presents how Hermes uses these sandboxes at Microsoft Ignite today, in session BRK448.
Thanks to @M12vc and the @Azure Container Apps team.

Kong has launched Volcano, a cloud platform that hosts AI apps and agents, bringing everything they need into one place.
Users can build apps with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex and publish them on Volcano, with built-in database and sign-in functionality.
Volcano can also find bugs in production apps and prepare fixes, which users can review and approve before they are applied. Agents can also pick up a build from a backup after a crash.
Marco Palladino (@subnetmarco)
At Kong we run half a quadrillion AI tokens a year, and I kept seeing agents stuck on clouds built for websites.
So we built a cloud for agents.
Volcano is live today: the self-healing agent cloud. Sandboxes, durable workflows, Postgres, hosting.
Video
— https://x.com/subnetmarco/status/2123424142569714004
items.title_ja:
Kong は、AI アプリとエージェントをホストするクラウド プラットフォームである Volcano を立ち上げ、必要なものすべてを 1 か所にまとめました。
ユーザーは、Claude Code、Cursor、または Codex を使用してアプリを構築し、組み込みのデータベースとサインイン機能を備えた Volcano で公開できます。
Volcano は実稼働アプリのバグを見つけて修正を準備することもでき、ユーザーは適用前にレビューして承認できます。エージェントは、クラッシュ後にバックアップからビルドを取得することもできます。
マルコ・パラディーノ (@subnetmarco)
Kong では年間 5,000 兆個の AI トークンを実行していますが、エージェントがウェブサイト用に構築されたクラウド上で立ち往生しているのを何度も目にしました。
そこで私たちはエージェント用のクラウドを構築しました。
Volcano は現在、自己修復エージェント クラウドとして稼働しています。サンドボックス、耐久性のあるワークフロー、Postgres、ホスティング。
